topics.body:
# Gmail

This bundled plugin applies only when the focused browser URL is `mail.google.com`.

It maps Gmail's fixed `g...` go-to destinations to current-tab navigation that preserves the active Gmail account/profile, does not create a new tab, does not full-reload Gmail, and does not depend on Gmail keyboard shortcuts being enabled: `gi` inbox, `gs` starred, `gb` snoozed, `gt` sent mail, `gd` drafts, `ga` all mail, `gk` tasks, and `gl` label. Safari and Chromium-family browsers use page hash navigation; Firefox AX-focuses the existing address bar and submits the target URL through Flash-owned synthetic text input, without using the Cmd-L shortcut or typing into the page. It maps `gn` and `gp` to Flash's browser history forward/back actions, like `L` and `H`, and maps `o` to Gmail's native open-selected-email shortcut.

It also owns `resource_archive`, `resource_next`, and `resource_previous` on Gmail thread pages by pressing Gmail's accessible toolbar buttons, so those actions do not depend on Gmail keyboard shortcuts being enabled.
